title: μετὰ τῆς κοάλας
learning_goal: Practice third-person present tense of movement and simple activity verbs (enter/exit, carry, play, throw, find, hide, eat, drink, sleep) with clear article use and common prepositions (ἐν, εἰς/ἐπί, ἐκ/διά, παρά, μετά).
plot: Koala eats and drinks at the table, goes outside to play and explore, then returns inside and goes to bed.

frames.text_english: The koala sits beside the table.
objects: Low round wooden table with a cream cloth and two small green cushions on the floor.
Small red-clay cup filled with clear water.
Small round loaf of golden-brown bread with a scored top.
Shiny red apple with a short brown stem and a small green leaf.
positioning: Koala sits on the right side of the table, facing left with her hands near the table edge.
The low round wooden table with a cream cloth and two small green cushions on the floor stands center-left in the frame.
The small red-clay cup filled with clear water sits near the front-right edge of the table.
The small round loaf of golden-brown bread with a scored top rests at the center of the table cloth.
The shiny red apple with a short brown stem and a small green leaf lies beside the loaf toward the back-left of the table.
